description: $0.09 via x402: up to TEN on-chain reads for ONE payment, run in parallel — native balance, nonce, contract-code check, ERC-20 balance, block number and gas price in any combination. Reconciling a wallet normally costs one payment per read; this is the same data for a fraction of the calls and the latency. Per-read failures are reported individually with a partial flag, so a batch never claims success it did not have.

reads.description: Comma-separated ops, max 10: balance:0xADDR | nonce:0xADDR | code:0xADDR | erc20:0xTOKEN:0xWALLET | blocknumber | gas

name: chain_batch_reads
